sar.narrative:
SUSPICIOUS ACTIVITY REPORT (SAR) — INVESTIGATION NARRATIVE
Case Reference: HHG-013

I. SUMMARY (WHAT):
Between 2016-12-09 05:39:29 and 2016-12-09 05:39:29, suspicious transaction activity totaling $35.66 USD was identified across 1 transaction(s) involving card C07671-K2 associated with customer profile C07671. The primary suspicious pattern identified is 'card_not_present_new_device'.

II. SUBJECTS & INSTRUMENTS (WHO):
Primary Customer Identifier: C07671
Primary Card Number Reference: C07671-K2
Connected / Correlated Cards: C11923, C13171, C02354
Associated Device Telemetry: Windows | chrome 66.0

III. TIMELINE & GEOGRAPHIC PROFILE (WHEN & WHERE):
Earliest Flagged Transaction Date: 2016-12-09 05:39:29
Latest Activity Timestamp: 2016-12-09 05:39:29
Affected Transaction Record IDs: 3526826

IV. METHOD OF OPERATION & EVIDENCE (WHY & HOW):
Device profile Windows observed across 3 other distinct customer accounts.; Transaction initiated from a newly observed device profile: Windows | chrome 66.0.; Bank upstream fraud detection model flagged transaction with high risk score of 0.76.; Cardholder denied authorizing the transaction and confirmed card remains in physical possession.
Multi-Entity Syndicate Linkage: Graph analysis revealed that the device profile (Windows | chrome 66.0) is shared across multiple cardholder profiles, indicating coordinated synthetic identity or card-not-present syndicate activity.

V. INSTITUTIONAL ACTION TAKEN:
The bank initiated immediate card control actions under Bank Fraud Policy v1.0. Customer validation confirmed unauthorized access. The card was permanently blocked and placed on fraud monitoring. This filing is submitted pursuant to BSA/AML compliance mandates.
